hooks.text: 骑着住在飞鲸上的飞狗，与朋友穿越手绘、程序生成的苏斯式天空旅程
hooks.excerpt: In Flock of Dogs, ride flying dogs that live on a flying whale. Together with your friends, go on a hand-drawn, procedurally-generated, Dr. Seussian, roguelike road trip through the sky.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 喂养并升级狗群，以飞鲸作为移动战斗站，再下洞穴挑战巨型兽王
hooks.excerpt: Feed, water, and level up your dogs Pilot a flying whale that acts as your mobile battle station Descend into caves to fight boss battles against massive Cave Beasts
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 购买者提供免费好友席位，多个拥有者还能叠加席位组成四人队伍
hooks.excerpt: A Friend Slot allows one of your online friends to join you for free! Anyone can download the "Flock of Dogs - Friend's Pass" and then join the game of someone who purchased Flock of Dogs. One Friend Slot comes with purchase Invite any friend (and each time, it can be a different friend) Friend Slots stack, so if two people own the game and are playing together, 2 more friends can join them using the Friend's Pass to make a team of 4.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
